newsitem.title: USA: General DataComm, Lucent in ATM pact.
newsitem.headline: General DataComm, Lucent in ATM pact.

text.p: General DataComm Inc on Tuesday unveiled Asynchronous Transfer Mode software that it developed with Lucent Technologies Inc, for the managament of transferring data over networks.
Financial details of the deal were not detailed.
GDC said its APEX software family and Lucent's GlobeView-2000 Broadband System software will makes management of voice, video and data traffic more efficient and cost-effective for network operators.
ATM is an emerging technology on which a new generation of higher speed mutimedia networks are being built that are better able to handle voice, video and data simultaneously.
